decisions.reason: The enclosed laser workstation line extends the firm's established laser offer into a growing industry. The firm is expanding, which gives it slack to carry the product while results are still uncertain, so there is no shortfall prompting search for alternatives.

The thermal inkjet printer sits close to the core business and has its own prominent web page, which signals satisfactory early performance. Keeping it rounds out the single-source portfolio across surfaces and applications.

The piezo inkjet printer is near the core offer and is featured on its own page. It also complements the thermal inkjet model for different substrates. Growth and investment give the firm ample slack, so there is little reason to drop it.
